title: This chair is a BEAST!
text:
This chair is a BEAST!. Upon opening the box, we were impressed with the fortitude of each part - it is very weighted and similar to chrome (at least in finish and heaviness). This is much akin to a Chevy Bel Air vs modern cars as far as comparing it to previous desk chairs which I have owned, it is clearly built to last and sustain a lot of weight and use.

I left the assembly to my partner, who said that other than the heaviness of the parts when wrangling them, was incredibly easy. The instructions do suggest that you make use of the box it arrived in to help prop parts as you screw them together because you will need the support, and he did this and said it made it much more manageable.

I walked into the room once it was finished and gaped at how large this chair is. In fact, I felt like a child climbing into the seat, my legs left to dangle and I kept scooting back further and further (You can lower it with the pneumatic lift so that your feet touch the ground, it also has nice rounding of the seat front to prevent your back of knee circulation from being cut off!). The seat is HUGE both front to back and side to side and can comfortably accommodate larger bodies. I never had so much room in desk chair seat before! But the solidity of this chair is what has me in awe - I feel safe and comfortable in it. No teetering, no awkward tilting, nothing bad! The only plastic parts to the structure of the chair is the pneumatic lift handle and the wheels (which seem more like high impact plastic and dense), so no fear of parts breaking under weight strain and movement.

I would say that the only downside to this chair is now my partner is jealous of it and we're going to have to get him one of his own so he that doesn't pilfer mine. Excellent desk chair, an easy 5 stars
